title: The founder's playbook: Building an AI-native startup
summary: Anthropic's comprehensive guide sharing strategies and best practices for building AI-native startups, based on lessons learned from working with numerous AI companies. The playbook covers product development, go-to-market strategies, team building, and scaling challenges specific to AI ventures.
problem_solved: Provides actionable guidance for founders navigating the unique challenges of building and scaling AI-native companies.
why_valuable: Offers insider perspectives from a leading AI company on proven strategies for succeeding in the rapidly evolving AI startup landscape.
